g.text: One continuous model for both regimes · Arrows denote model dependencies or heat flow, not electrical wires
Four dynamic states: wire current I, seed electron temperature Te, seed phonon temperature Tph, and normal-domain resistance Rd.
Default closure: domainEnergyClosure = 0; domainSuperheatClosure = 0. The domain has no independent temperature or energy state.
Domain Joule power I²Rd is a diagnostic; the seed electron equation includes I²Rseed. No Geiger/calorimetric mode switch is present.
Smooth bounds, heat-capacity laws, and the critical-nucleus calculation are defined in the model library and detailed in docs/snspd.md.
